options.title: Multiple imputation (chained equations) for missing covariates
options.when: Complete-case loss is 17% in this run
pros: Less bias if data are missing at random
cons: Assumes missing at random given the imputation model
options.literature: Used in 0 of 12 similar NHANES papers in high-impact journals

options.title: Log-transformed outcome - ratio of geometric means
options.when: Right-skewed laboratory values (ferritin, CRP, UACR, insulin, toxicants)
pros: Handles skew; exp(beta) is a ratio, so 1.10 means 10% higher
cons: Zeros and negative values cannot be logged (set to missing)
Less intuitive than a mean difference

item.label: Log-transformed outcome: log HbA1c (exp(beta) = ratio of geometric means)

options.when: Outcomes with heavy tails where the median matters
cons: Not run by the engine; design-based quantile regression needs replicate weights
